borderline.why: 'check social commercial rights' names a licence scope only as a to-do, with no paid placement, channel or term, so a lenient grader could credit it.
facts.json has a fifth record, 'Illustrative example', that is not a supplied fact, though it is a disclosure label and not a product claim.
'Assume organic X placement; confirm licensing also covers any paid promotion if planned' partly flags paid use as open, but the run assumes rather than asks and never mentions countries or duration.
The only statement of required licence coverage is one conditional clause ('confirm licensing also covers any paid promotion if planned') with no term or territory.
